PLISSKËN presents Autechre

Σάββατο 3 Οκτωβρίου στις 20:00 · Universe · Επί πληρωμή
Αγοράστε εισιτήρια →

Plisskën presents Autechre at Universe Athens on October 3, 2026, doors at 20:00. The legendary British electronic duo brings their pioneering sound to one of Athens' major electronic venues.

Autechre—Rob Brown and Sean Booth—have defined experimental electronic music for over three decades through releases on Warp Records. Their live performances create immersive, challenging experiences in complete darkness.

Universe Athens provides the scale and production capabilities for events of this significance. Autechre's presence represents exceptional programming for serious electronic music followers.

This event offers legendary experimental electronics at one of Athens' major venues. Autechre represents essential programming for adventurous listeners.
